owner_intent: JSON/JSONL evidence is the blood ledger of Imperium receipts, matrices, reports and gates.
Mechanicus must separate canonical JSON evidence from negative fixtures, quarantine records and patch payload candidates.
Malformed fixtures and quarantine debt must remain visible; only canonical parse debt blocks readiness.
core_laws: Canonical evidence JSON must parse cleanly.
JSONL must contain exactly one JSON value per non-empty line.
Expected negative fixtures must be classified, not fixed.
Quarantine evidence debt must be reported, not silently counted as current source failure.
Strict JSON lane pass is not schema correctness, semantic correctness, or full evidence truth.

classes.canonical_evidence: current non-patch JSON/JSONL outside fixtures and quarantine
classes.expected_negative_fixture: malformed/invalid JSON fixtures used for validator tests
classes.quarantine_evidence_debt: historic/pending/quarantined records that are not current canonical evidence
classes.patch_payload_candidate: WARP patch files not yet landed as canonical evidence
